limits: Counted static module tables, relocations and forwarded-export targets plus separately provenance-tagged previously observed startup DLL roots. Other computed DosLoadModule/DosQueryProcAddr choices and execution frequency are not inferred.
fixupCount counts encoded relocation records/forwarders, not dynamic calls or all links in a source chain.
Export presence, ABI policies, located source bodies and explicit markers do not establish complete semantics.

Internal-entry fixups are decoded using the primary IBM LX specification; opaque parameter-type payloads, compressed chain expansion and unsupported format records remain explicit rather than invented.

Provider precedence follows ball/system_modules.h plus selected Mesa/TLS policy; directory lookup uses importer directory then configured LIBPATH. Optional Lotus DLL closures are a separate conservative superset.
Missing-export census is a frozen source/generated-table observation, not proof the changing or installed runtime has identical exports.
All prototypeApplicationAllowed fields remain false for this audit; declarations, manual references, model-derived RET observations and semantics are distinct.
No target was executed, no Ghidra analysis was launched by this worker, and no user-ball files were written.

limits: Static current-program analysis only; the target was not executed.
Unexported functions are recovered internal candidates, not proven source-private interfaces.
Program bytes include loader relocations and any analyst modifications; they are not original raw-file byte claims.
Decode contexts and decoded returns are observations, not proof of a calling convention or automatic ABI reassignment.
Fingerprints are architecture/model/decode-context/method-qualified and are not architecture-neutral semantic hashes.
Type IDs hash qualified local shape and reference keys; graph references preserve cycles and graph hash captures actual reference IDs.
Prototypes, storage, layouts and calling conventions are Ghidra model-derived unless separately evidenced.
Bounds: 20000 functions/types; 16MiB program bytes; 512KiB per function; 200000 fields/references/CFG records.
